name: Copart
whoCanAccess: Anyone can browse lots. Bidding is usually a licensed dealer, dismantler, or a broker who charges a fee. Some states allow public bidding with extra paperwork.
publicData: Year, make, model, photos, damage notes, title type, sale location, and current bid when Copart chooses to show them. We do not scrape lots.
notes: Insurance salvage lane. As-is. Buyer fees are real money.

name: IAA (Insurance Auto Auctions)
whoCanAccess: Public search is open. Bidding typically needs a dealer license or an IAA public-buyer / broker path.
publicData: Lot photos, damage, odometer remarks, title group, and sale time. Live bid history stays on IAA.
notes: Sister salvage lane to Copart. Same rule: we link out, we do not harvest.

name: Manheim
whoCanAccess: Licensed dealers and approved wholesale buyers. Not a consumer checkout.
publicData: Marketing pages and some condition reports behind login. No public lot feed we can legally republish.
notes: Cox wholesale. If you are not a dealer, this door stays shut.

name: ADESA
whoCanAccess: Licensed dealers. Openlane / ADESA digital lanes are not a consumer auction.
publicData: Public site explains the product. Inventory is behind dealer credentials.
notes: Dealer wholesale. We will not fake a consumer bid button.

name: GovPlanet
whoCanAccess: Public registration. Surplus military and government equipment, including fleet vehicles.
publicData: Lot photos, location, inspection notes they publish, and current bid.
notes: IronPlanet / Ritchie Bros. government surplus. Inspect before you bid.

name: GSA Auctions
whoCanAccess: U.S. public. Federal surplus vehicles and equipment.
publicData: Official lot descriptions, locations, and bid status on gsaauctions.gov.
notes: Use their keyword search for year / make / model. No dealer license.

name: Copart Canada
whoCanAccess: Browse is public. Bidding follows Canadian provincial rules — often a license or broker.
publicData: Same family as Copart US: lots, photos, title remarks.

name: Bring a Trailer
whoCanAccess: Anyone can watch. Bidding needs a free BaT account. No dealer license.
publicData: Full listing write-up, photos, comment thread, reserve status, and sold prices after the gavel.
notes: Public consumer auction. This is the opposite of a Copart lane.

name: Cars & Bids
whoCanAccess: Public listings. Bid with a consumer account.
publicData: Photos, seller story, bid history, no-reserve vs reserve.
notes: Modern enthusiast cars. Public, not wholesale.

name: Mecum
whoCanAccess: Watch the docket for free. Bidding is a bidder number at the event or online — not a dealer license.
publicData: Upcoming lots, estimates, and results Mecum publishes.
notes: Live collector auctions. Preview on their site.

name: Barrett-Jackson
whoCanAccess: Public docket. Bidding is a registered bidder, not a dealer plate.
publicData: Lot lists, photos, and hammer prices they post.
notes: No-reserve spectacle auctions. Fees are not a footnote.
